author: Nostalgia Nerd
description:
I visited Tate Modern’s Electric Dreams — an exhibition exploring how artists have captured our digital lives, from early computers to AI and online identity. It’s a fascinating blend of nostalgia, technology, and emotion; showing how our relationship with machines has changed over the decades.

Walk through the show with me as we revisit the optimism, anxiety, and strange beauty of the digital age.

#TateModern #ElectricDreams #DigitalArt #RetroTech #TechCulture
title: Inside your “Electric" Dreams
